description: This file contains utility functions for parsing, manipulating, and interacting with URLs and hostnames, including appending query parameters, extracting host info, and checking hostname properties.

classes.name: QueryIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing key-value pairs in URL query string.

methods.name: AppendQueryParameter
methods.description: Creates a new URL with the specified query parameter appended.

methods.name: AppendOrReplaceQueryParameter
methods.description: Creates a new URL with the specified query parameter added or replaced.

methods.name: AppendOrReplaceRef
methods.description: Creates a new URL with the specified fragment (ref) added or replaced.

methods.name: QueryIterator
methods.description: Class for iterating over query key-value pairs.

methods.name: GetValueForKeyInQuery
methods.description: Finds the value for a given key in URL query string.

methods.name: ParseHostAndPort
methods.description: Parses host and port from input string.

methods.name: GetHostAndPort
methods.description: Returns host:port string for a URL.

methods.name: GetHostAndOptionalPort
methods.description: Returns host with optional port if default port is omitted.

methods.name: TrimEndingDot
methods.description: Removes trailing dot from hostname.

methods.name: GetHostOrSpecFromURL
methods.description: Returns hostname or full URL spec if hostname is empty.

methods.name: GetSuperdomain
methods.description: Returns the superdomain by removing the leftmost label.

methods.name: IsSubdomainOf
methods.description: Checks if one hostname is a subdomain of another.

methods.name: CanonicalizeHost
methods.description: Returns canonical hostname and fills host info.

methods.name: IsCanonicalizedHostCompliant
methods.description: Checks if hostname complies with RFC rules.

methods.name: IsHostnameNonUnique
methods.description: Checks if hostname is non-unique or non-assignable.

methods.name: IsLocalhost
methods.description: Checks if URL host is localhost.

methods.name: SimplifyUrlForRequest
methods.description: Removes user info and reference from URL.

methods.name: ChangeWebSocketSchemeToHttpScheme
methods.description: Converts ws/wss schemes to http/https.

methods.name: GetIdentityFromURL
methods.description: Extracts username and password from URL.

methods.name: HasGoogleHost
methods.description: Checks if URL host is a Google server.

methods.name: IsGoogleHost
methods.description: Checks if hostname is a Google server.

methods.name: IsGoogleHostWithAlpnH3
methods.description: Checks if Google host indicates H3 support.

methods.name: IsLocalHostname
methods.description: Checks if hostname is a local hostname.

methods.name: UnescapePercentEncodedUrl
methods.description: Unescapes percent-encoded URL string.
